title: Grateful Dead Live at Soldiers and Sailors War Memorial Hall on 1979-12-10
venue: Soldiers and Sailors War Memorial Hall
lineage: Cassette > Sony TC-D5M (no Dolby) > Realtek AC97 > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH v.1.0.0.72 (for SBE-fix, FLAC compression, and checksums) > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Muddy audience recording captures an outstanding, high‑energy Truckin' performance.
ai_review.review: The two fan reviews agree the source is an audience tape that suffers from hiss and a generally muddied sound, making it less than ideal for audiophiles.  However, the show itself shines – especially the Truckin' that one reviewer calls possibly the best ever, indicating strong energy and musical fire despite the recording limitations.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised (especially Truckin') while recording quality is noted as poor/muddy; weighted average yields a solid >4‑star rating but limited review count reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muddied by hiss and background noise; overall clarity is compromised, though the performance can still be heard.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set structure; reviewers highlight high energy but give no specifics about pacing or transitions.
